result.title: Does Recursive Knowledge Construction Help Agents Verify Consensus Claims in Science?
result.summary: Recent scientific agents build knowledge recursively by retrieving evidence, constructing an intermediate state, and judging whether that state contains sufficient information. These agents are evaluated end-to-end, usually without ground truth, so the effect of each design choice is unknown. Here, we examined two design axes: (1) what the recursion builds (the state of evidence) and (2) what controls it (the judge that decides when to stop). To measure them, we defined consensus scientific claim verification and measured these effects on this task, where a system must establish a claim's consensus stance from the open literature. We built a new consensus claim dataset, ProClaim-eval, including 718 claims with SUPPORT and REFUTE gold labels from five expert-curated databases spanning molecular biology, nuclear physics, and astronomy. Our instrument, ProClaim, persists an evidence state outside the model's context, so each axis can be studied with the other held fixed. Against verification systems and general-purpose agent harnesses, ProClaim ranks among the top three, with a significant advantage over the harnesses. We found that the evidence state improves performance over in-context accumulation, and it also matters what is stored in it. In addition, a trained judge that reads the evidence state performs better than fixed-round stopping. A judge trained separately and never exposed to ProClaim-eval achieves the highest agreement with the gold labels on three of five subsets, where it matches the off-the-shelf Claude Sonnet~4.6 judge and outperforms Claude Haiku~4.5. Our results support recursively maintaining a structured evidence state outside the model's context as an effective design for verifying claims in scientific agents.

AI.brief_summary: 论文定义「共识科学主张验证」任务，构建含 718 条 SUPPORT/REFUTE 金标的 ProClaim-eval 数据集，并提出 ProClaim：在模型上下文外持久化证据状态，以分别考察「递归构建何种证据状态」与「何物控制停止」两条设计轴，发现结构化证据状态优于上下文内累积，训练过的判据优于固定轮数停止。
AI.relevance_reason: 把证据状态移出上下文并用独立训练的 judge 决定何时停止，与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、状态表示以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本分析高度同构，可供核查；但该工作为纯文本检索场景，无 latent 视觉状态，迁移需自行验证。
